title: From Hype to ROI: An Economic Model for LLM Adoption in Information Systems and Security Operations
abstract: arXiv:2610.33352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) promise significant efficiency gains across information-intensive operations by automating repetitive language-based tasks. However, adoption decisions remain largely opportunistic, as organizations struggle to move from pilots to sustainable industrialization. Without systematic economic frameworks, practitioners cannot assess whether LLM investments create value in a given context.   This paper develops a general economic model to support informed LLM adoption decisions in operational information systems. Facing high uncertainty, we represent parameters as random variables centered on authoritative benchmarks, and evaluate the model by Monte Carlo simulation across pessimistic-to-optimistic assumptions on LLM efficiency. translated_title: 从炒作到投资回报：信息系统与安全运营中大语言模型采用的经济模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通过自动化重复性的基于语言的任务，有望在信息密集型运营中带来显著的效率提升。然而，当前的采用决策在很大程度上仍是机会主义的，因为组织难以从试点走向可持续的工业化落地。在缺乏系统性经济框架的情况下，从业者无法评估LLM投资在特定环境中是否能够创造价值。本文开发了一个通用的经济模型，以支持在运营型信息系统中的LLM采用决策。面对高度的不确定性，我们将模型参数表示为以权威基准为中心的随机变量，并通过对LLM效率从悲观到乐观的各种假设进行蒙特卡洛模拟来评估该模型。投资回报率（ROI）的分布显示了每种配置下的盈利概率和风险价值，并附有对其主要驱动因素的敏感性分析。作为首个应用实例……
tldr: 本文提出了一个面向信息系统与安全运营的通用LLM采用经济模型，通过蒙特卡洛模拟刻画ROI分布与风险价值，帮助组织在高度不确定性下评估LLM投资的盈利概率并做出有依据的采用决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general economic model for LLM adoption in information systems and security operations, using Monte Carlo simulation to derive ROI distributions and Value at Risk under uncertainty, thereby enabling informed and evidence-based adoption decisions.
